title: Hospitals and Health Care Complex Cost Report (CMS-2552-10)
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: Hospital count and two activity/occupation groups reconstruct hours and labor cost.
score_rationale.provenance: Dated STAR registry and 2023 OEWS occupation inputs; burden hours inherited.
score_rationale.segmentation: Reporting and recordkeeping separated, but hospital complexity variation not modeled.
score_rationale.labor: Occupation match and doubling stated; 100% benefit/overhead markup is not derived.
score_rationale.item13: Capital zero asserted without discussion of O&M and cost-report software.
score_rationale.item14: MAC and CMS totals supplied without hours, rates or allocation methodology.
score_rationale.item15: Old/new hospital counts, time and cost shown, with transfers from two controls; transfer-to-average-hour derivation unclear.
score_rationale.validation: Administrative population count supported; 675 hours lacks measured timing validation.
score_rationale.consistency: Main products reconcile; transferred requirement counts do not directly explain one additional hour for all hospitals.

assumptions: 6044 hospital count from STAR as of 2024-12-27.
Transferred reporting partly automated, but one-hour average addition is not derived.

reconstruction_issues: The transferred counts and stated former times imply 2556.5 hours before further automation, not the 6044-hour addition; different remaining recordkeeping scope may explain this but is not quantified.
Federal contractor and CMS totals are not independently reconstructable.
methods_worth_testing: Maintain a cross-control transfer ledger with before/after automation and recordkeeping scope.
